summary.text: Roger Skraba is a Republican state representative from Minnesota House District 3A who has served since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A business owner and U.S. Army Reserve veteran, he was born in Ely, Minnesota.

paragraphs.text: Roger Skraba was born in Ely, Minnesota, graduated from Ely Memorial High School, and earned a bachelor's degree from North Dakota State University in 1985.
He served in the U.S. Army Reserve from 1986 to 1994, and his career experience includes working as a business owner and public board chairman.
Skraba assumed office on January 3, 2023, succeeding Rob Ecklund.

In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Housing Finance and Policy, Legacy Finance, Capital Investment, and Transportation Finance and Policy committees, and he is co-vice chair of the Legacy Finance Committee.
